basic_details.job_title: LUVAS Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 8 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Lala Lajpat Rai University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, Hisar (LUVAS) has announced 8 temporary vacancies for Teaching Associate (Dairy Technology), Teaching Associate (Dairy Engineering), Teaching Associate (Dairy Chemistry), and Teaching Associate (Dairy Microbiology) posts under advertisement number LUVAS/CoDST/TA/2026/01. Eligible candidates must apply through the offline application process by submitting the filled-up form along with self-attested photocopies of required certificates by hand or through post to The Dean CoDST, LUVAS, Hisar, Haryana on or before 5 November 2026. important_dates.interview_date: To be intimated in due course of time on the university website

qualification.details: Essential Qualifications: | Bachelor's Degree (B.Tech./B.Sc./B.V.Sc. & A.H.) from a recognized institute. Master's Degree (M.Tech./M.Sc./M.V.Sc.) in the relevant subject from a recognized institute. Preference shall be given to candidates possessing a Ph.D. degree in the relevant subject from a recognized institute.

selection_process: The selection is based on a 100-mark evaluation criterion comprising academic degrees

Bachelor's Degree: Maximum 20 marks (on pro-rata system) Master's Degree: Maximum 20 marks (on pro-rata system) Doctoral Degree: Maximum 10 marks (on pro-rata system) Additional Qualifications: University level academic awards like Gold Medal (05 marks); Publications with NAAS rating ≥6 (1 mark each) and NAAS rating <6 (0.5 mark each) up to 10 marks. Power Point Presentation: Maximum 15 marks on any topic of the candidate's choice as an undergraduate teacher. Performance in Interview: Maximum 20 marks.
important_instructions: Candidates belonging to states other than Haryana will be treated as General category candidates. Applicants applying for different types of positions must submit a separate application form for each position. Applicants applying under any reserved category must attach a self-attested copy of the relevant category certificate. The engagement is purely temporary, non-regular, non-tenurial, and time-bound for the Academic Year 2026-27 (co-terminus in June 2027) and is not against any sanctioned post. Selected candidates shall be entitled only to 15 Casual Leaves and 02 Restricted Holidays in an academic year, with no other allowances or benefits. Selected candidates must join duty within 15 days from the date of issue of the order. Selected candidates must produce a medical certificate of fitness from the CMO of the university at the time of joining. Applications will be summarily rejected if unsigned, incomplete, not on the prescribed form, missing essential qualifications, or received after the last date.

content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications on the prescribed format (Annexure-A) along with self-attested copies of all testimonials, certificates, publications, and other relevant documents by hand or through post to the following address: The Dean CoDST, LUVAS, Hisar, Haryana-125004 Applicants must mention the title on the envelope as: “Application for the position of Teaching Associate in the College of Dairy Science and Technology vide Advt. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in LUVAS Teaching Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 8 vacancies are available for Teaching Associate posts across Dairy Technology, Dairy Engineering, Dairy Chemistry, and Dairy Microbiology disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form is 05.11.2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree (B.Tech./B.Sc./B.V.Sc. & A.H.) and a Master's Degree (M.Tech./M.Sc./M.V.Sc.) in the relevant subject. Preference is given to Ph.D. degree holders.

faq.question: Q4. What is the fixed monthly honorarium for the Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs. 60,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for LUVAS Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their offline applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of required certificates by hand or through post to The Dean CoDST, LUVAS, Hisar, Haryana-125004.

faq.question: Q7. Are candidates from other states eligible to apply under reserved categories?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to states other than Haryana will be treated as General category candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary, non-regular, non-tenurial, and time-bound for the Academic Year 2026-27, co-terminus in June 2027.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the interview schedule be published?
faq.answer: The detailed subject-wise interview schedule will be intimated in due course of time on the university website.
